    Made for the Squeekchain community.Free to play. Just one more run.

    Small paws. Simple rules.

    Keep Squeektoshi running inside the wheel for as long as you can.

    • Jump: tap, click, or press Space, ↑, or W. Hold for a higher jump. Release before the next jump.
    • Watch the rim: hop over red pegs. Tall pegs need a full jump. One trip ends the run.
    • Snack as you go: seeds earn 25 points and rare stars earn 150, times your multiplier.
    • Keep going: earn 10 points a second, times a multiplier that grows from x1.0 to x12.
    • Live wheel bonus: when the real hamster is running, all points earn an extra 25%. The game always works without it.

    M: mute sound · Escape: pause
    Best scores stay on this device. Claimed scores join the worldwide board.
